description: Spawn a 3D avatar from a curated default (preset="default" or "cz") or from a custom GLB URL. Returns a sessionId other tools (dress_avatar, viewer_url, speak) reference, plus the avatar GLB URL and a ready-to-open three.ws viewer link.

name.description: Display name for the avatar persona.

persona.description: Short persona/personality blurb (used by callers; not enforced server-side).

voice.description: OpenAI TTS voice the speak tool should use for this session.
